newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady, seen gaining further.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady, seen gaining further.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady at reduced levels on Friday and is seen gaining further, dealers said.
"Sentiment at the close remained steady but I expect the market to move up next week on fresh buying support," one dealer said.
Dealers said consumer and retail demand however remained low but restricted arrivals kept market in a narrow price band.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,235/1,265 rupees while M-30 was steady at 1,250/1,318 rupees.
